source_of_truth: Curated static reference: Glam Creator Hub PRD v1 as documented in this fixture. NOT a live read from any external repo — the fixture is reproducible from this file alone. Treated as a generic integrated-product-surface example per D013; project name is content, not a product-code dependency.

user_journeys.name: create
user_journeys.description: Creator opens Creator Hub and starts a new post: chooses a try-on result from their history (or composes new), enters caption + tags, picks an audience (public / followers / collaboration), and saves a draft. Drafts persist locally and sync to backend so the creator can resume on another device. The draft step is required — creators cannot publish without first saving a draft (this enforces the moderation-pre-screen the PRD specifies).
acceptance_signals: Try-on history loads within 2s on Wi-Fi
Caption accepts up to 280 chars; tags up to 10
Draft persists across app restart
Draft surfaces on second device within 30s of save

user_journeys.name: edit
user_journeys.description: Creator opens an existing draft (or published post) and edits caption / tags / audience. Edits to a published post create a revision history entry visible in analytics; edits to a draft just overwrite. The edit experience uses the same composer as create — no separate edit surface.
acceptance_signals: Edit surface is the unified composer, not a separate screen
Published-post edits log a revision with timestamp + diff
Concurrent edits across devices surface a conflict-resolution UI

user_journeys.name: preview
user_journeys.description: Creator previews how a draft will render in the public feed before publishing — the same renderer the public sees. Preview is interactive: tapping the preview's like / comment affordances shows a coach-mark explaining 'this is preview; engagement disabled'. Preview must reflect any pending moderation flags (e.g. 'this caption contains a flagged term — review before publishing').
acceptance_signals: Preview uses the same render path as the public feed
Moderation-flag banner surfaces when caption / tags trip the screening rules
Engagement actions show coach-mark, not error toast

user_journeys.name: publish
user_journeys.description: Creator confirms publish from preview. Publish triggers: (1) backend moderation pass (synchronous, <3s), (2) feed-fanout job (async, propagates within 60s), (3) push-notification fan-out to followers if audience=followers / public, (4) analytics impression-tracker initialization. If moderation fails, creator returns to compose with a flag annotation; if any non-moderation step fails, post is published but a 'publishing in progress' banner surfaces in the creator's feed view until the async fan-out completes.
acceptance_signals: Moderation pass completes within 3s
Feed fan-out completes within 60s for ≥99% of publishes
Push-notification dispatch matches audience
Analytics impression-tracker is initialized synchronously with publish

user_journeys.name: analytics
user_journeys.description: Creator views analytics on the dashboard: impressions, likes, comments, shares, follower-growth attributable to this post. Default range is 7-day; user can switch to 30-day or all-time. Each metric tile is tappable, opening a per-post breakdown when the metric is post-level and a per-period breakdown when the metric is account-level. Analytics tiles refresh every 5 minutes; staler data shows a 'last updated <time>' subtext.
acceptance_signals: Default 7-day range loads within 2s
Range selector preserves selection across navigation
Tile drill-down opens the right breakdown (post-level vs account-level)
Stale-data subtext appears when last refresh > 5 minutes old

user_journeys.name: profile
user_journeys.description: Creator profile shows the public-facing identity: avatar, handle, bio, follower / following counts, and a feed of published posts. Editing the profile (avatar / bio / handle) is gated by the unified composer's audience-aware preview — handle changes show a 'this URL will redirect' warning since the old handle URL stays valid for 30 days post-change. Profile is the canonical entry point creators send to brands during collaboration negotiation.
acceptance_signals: Owner / visitor views differ in available actions (Edit vs Follow)
Avatar upload accepts JPG / PNG up to 5MB
Handle change preserves the 30-day redirect from the old handle

required_evidence: End-to-end walk: create → edit → preview → publish → analytics → click into single-post drill-down
Publish-failure recovery walk: trigger moderation flag, return to compose, resolve, re-publish
Analytics drill-down: from analytics tile, tap a published post, verify the per-post breakdown matches the tile total
Cross-device draft resume: save draft on iOS, open Creator Hub on web within 30s, confirm draft surfaces
Profile handle change: change handle, verify old-handle URL redirects for 30 days
non_goals: Android Creator Hub (Android creator experience is a separate track)
Live-streaming integration (Creator Hub v1 is post-based; live is v2)
Brand-side collaboration management UI (creators see their side; brand UI is a separate product)
completion_test: Creator Hub works as a unified product surface — a creator can move from create → edit → preview → publish → analytics → drill-down → profile and feel one cohesive product, not a collection of feature screens. The journeys compose: a creator who publishes a post should see analytics for that post within 5 minutes, and tapping the post in analytics should drill into the same canonical post detail the public sees on the profile.
